purpose: Source-authored contracts for Dungeon target-state predicates. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.

requiredRuntimeSemantics: current target has no qualifying adjacent ally/support geometry
forbiddenSubstitutes: any non-adjacent target counted as isolated without full neighbor scan
any debuffed target counted as isolated target
global enemy count counted as target isolation
attacker isolation counted as target isolation
damage event counted without target geometry proof
Dungeon faction membership counted as isolated target
RequiresIsolatedTarget.notes: Predator's Instruction requires current-board target isolation geometry for the affected stack. Runtime must prove target identity, neighbor scan semantics, damage ordering, and law-owner correlation.

requiredRuntimeSemantics: current target stack is numerically outnumbered by the law-owner/acting stack
counterattack or doctrine action target identity
live stack counts at action time
forbiddenSubstitutes: smaller army counted as target outnumbered
lower tier counted as target outnumbered
damaged stack counted as outnumbered without live count comparison
global friendly/enemy unit counts counted as target outnumbered
target surrounded geometry counted as numeric outnumbering
counterattack event counted without target stack count proof
RequiresTargetOutnumbered.notes: Outnumber requires a live numeric stack-size comparison for the current target in the doctrine/counterattack context. Runtime must prove stack identities, count comparison, action timing, and law-owner correlation.

requiredRuntimeProof: isolated target predicate truth table proof
acting or law-owner stack identity proof
counterattack or doctrine action correlation proof
